description: This source file implements the RBUS data model provider for TR-069 host interface, including handlers for get/set operations, event subscription, and RBUS initialization. It manages parameter registration, data type conversions, and communication with RBUS and the data model.

methods.name: TR_Dml_GetHandler
methods.description: Handles RBUS get requests by retrieving parameter info from the data model, calling host interface get message handler, and returning the value or default.

methods.name: TR_Dml_SetHandler
methods.description: Handles RBUS set requests by validating parameter info, converting data types, and calling host interface set message handler.

methods.name: TR_Dml_EventSubHandler
methods.description: Manages event subscription, enabling or disabling auto-publish based on event name.

methods.name: init_rbus_dml_provider
methods.description: Initializes RBUS, registers data elements based on the data model parameter list, and sets up handlers for get/set and events.

methods.name: setRbusStringParam
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value in RBUS.

methods.name: getRbusStringParam
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value from RBUS.
